_about: Re-dating Theographic's Old Testament (Ussher's chronology) to modern conservative dates. Each anchor pins one Theographic event (by eventID) to its modern year; anything between two anchors is placed by straight-line interpolation between them, on Theographic's year after converting from astronomical years (0 and below lose one, so -1490 is 1491 BC). The Judah kings in kings.json add an anchor each from their `tg` reign event. From `identityFrom` on, Theographic's (converted) years are kept as they are. The Genesis anchors are consistent with lives.json, which counts back from Abram's birth in 2166 BC: Ussher's dates for that stretch move by a constant 170 years, the Egypt years stretch from Ussher's 215 to Exodus 12:40's 430, and from the Exodus to the Temple everything moves 45 years later.

anchors.note: Creation (Adam, from the Genesis 5 and 11 ages)
Birth of Abram (1 Kings 6:1 + Exodus 12:40 + Genesis 21:5, 25:26, 47:9)
Birth of Moses (80 at the Exodus, Exodus 7:7)
The Exodus (480 years before the Temple, 1 Kings 6:1)
Death of Solomon and the division
